title: The progress announcer emits per-file and aggregate progress through a polite live-region wrapper
asA: operator watching an upload progress on a screen reader or a low-vision magnifier
iWant: a polite live-region tick every 10 percent of aggregate progress that names how many files have completed out of how many
soThat: I know the upload is still working without watching the screen and I can tell when it stalls

acceptanceCriteria.description: The upload region ships a [data-live-region="polite"] wrapper with aria-live="polite" preseeded at render time. During an upload the wrapper's textContent matches /^\d+ of \d+ files, \d{1,3} percent$/ and the numeric aggregate percent advances monotonically. Per-file rows carry [data-file-row] with a [data-file-progress] element whose text or aria-valuenow reflects the per-file percent. The pack drives /upload?transport=multipart, starts the upload, and reads the wrapper text plus one per-file progress value before completion.
